## What was tried
Separate finding from tracking report #557, assignment #354. On November16, genuine public in-process Click probes under existing confinement on frozen revisions `5e513796b8f2087ef79323dbf928aaa9924508a0` and `d4d1662a85850cc25ab8546b79e14ce1d9d4dc76` checked swarm scaffold and validate-lenses help against actual run parsing.

Both help surfaces mention `--custom-prompt-dir`, but supplying that run flag is rejected with exit2, No such option. Custom prompt configuration belongs in the job specification instead. This is unsupported-option guidance, not evidence that job-file custom prompts themselves fail.

## Relevant files and links
- Tracking report: https://github.com/IronbellyOrg/IronClaude/issues/557; assignment: https://github.com/IronbellyOrg/IronClaude/issues/354.
- `src/superclaude/cli/swarm/commands.py:435-439`: stale validate-lenses help.
- `docs/testing/v5.0.0/user/D14-swarm.md:151-187`: records custom-option guidance mismatch.
- Local actual help/rejection captures: `.dev/troubleshoot/bug-swarm-five-claims-20261116033105/artifacts/{release,current}/swarm-observation.json`. Not uploaded. Source checked against issue-review worktree; run identities recorded in both captures.

## Done when
Scaffold and validate-lenses help consistently describe the supported job-file custom prompt configuration and stop advertising an uncallable run flag. Add help/parser regression checks. Do not introduce an unrelated option or change job semantics merely to match stale wording.

## Pick-up note
Reporting split only, user authorized November16. Do not fix yet under354. Existing actual help/parser rejection captures are reused; no new test or model run, and no claim that every custom-prompt mechanism was tested. Keep #557 as original grouped evidence. This addresses misleading help, not shared stub identity or product hardening.

**What I ask of you.** (1) Decide the right workflow for this fix. `HOW-WE-WORK.md` says a change across more than one source file needs a written plan, `/sc:workflow` then `/sc:implement`; a one-line text fix with its test can be done directly. (2) Post that workflow on this issue now, unless it already says it. (3) Then start on it. Open the pull request with `/sc:pr-submit` against IronbellyOrg/IronClaude only. The "do not fix yet" limit in this issue applied during the #354 validation and no longer applies.
